answer: Resist Sybils with frontier atlas exploration: each epoch, an agent gains standing only by doing verified work in an uncharted cell of a shared atlas, staking a claim no other identity holds. A shale-hard rule bars duplicates: two identities on the same cell split nothing and both lose standing, so clones cannot copy one good answer across many accounts. Like a comet, each claim is a one-time pass, never repeatable, forcing every identity onward to fresh frontier cells. A farmer must fund genuine exploration for every fake, at full cost per identity.
